historical_record.description: Three non-residential structures stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to allow development of a lot exceeding 5,000 square feet in area at 2443-2445 Clement Street, demolishing an existing one-story shed and a one-story garage and partially demolishing the rear half of the commercial store, with new construction of a four-story, nine-unit mixed-use building.
